title: Suparipak
description: Suparipak is a specialized herbal formulation containing processed betel nut (Supari) cooked with milk, ghee, sugar, and uterine-toning herbs for female health. This premier formulation restores vitality to women during post-delivery recovery. Cures leucorrhea (white discharge) through antimicrobial and astringent action. Tones the uterine walls strengthening reproductive tissues. Relieves lower backache common in women. Addresses general weakness.
dosage: 10–15 grams in the morning and evening with warm milk
